July    31    37.

Mrs. A.I. Ambrose,
55 Mitchell Street,
Glebe,
Sydney, New South Wales,
Australia.

Madam,

I have to acknowledge receipt of your
letter dated June 24, 1937, and to inform you that
your husband, Mr. S.R.R. Ambrose, is still employed
as Chief Examiner in the Chinese Maritime Customs,
Old Ningpo Wharf, Shanghai, and resides at No. 357
Brenan Road.

I am, Madam,
Your obedient servant,

(Sd) K. M. Bourne
Deputy Commissioner of Police
in Charge.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. ............
Special Branch - CS6. Station,
REPORT
Date July 31, 1937.

Subject Communication dated June 24, 1937 from Mrs. A.I. AMBROSE,
55 Mitchell Street, Sydney, New South Wales, Australia.

Made by and Forwarded by D.S. Pitts.

Enquiries indicate that the contents of the attached
communication are fundamentally correct.

Mr. S.R.R. AMBROSE at present holds the rank of
Chief Examiner (A) in the Chinese Maritime Customs and
is attached to the Old Ningpo Wharf. His private
address is 35F Brenan Road, where he is living with a
woman of Russian nationality.

Mr. S.R.R. AMBROSE owes considerable amounts of
money to various persons in Shanghai and it is learned
that Mr. H. BROWETT, Solicitor and Advocate, of 34
Museum Road, has been acting on behalf of certain of his
creditors in an effort to effect a settlement.

During the course of this enquiry nothing has been
done that might embarrass Mr. AMBROSE in his present
position in the Chinese Maritime Customs.

D.S. Pitts.

D. S.

el.
D.C. (Special Branch).

档案编号 ____
特务科 - CS6。分局，
报告
日期：1937年7月31日。

事由：关于澳大利亚新南威尔士州悉尼米切尔街55号A.I. 安布罗斯夫人1937年6月24日来函的通信。

由警佐皮茨（D.S. Pitts）办理并转呈。

经查询表明，所附信函内容基本属实。

S.R.R. 安布罗斯先生目前在中国海关担任首席验估员（A级），隶属于老宁波码头。其私人住址为白伦路35F号，他与一名俄罗斯国籍女子同居于此。

S.R.R. 安布罗斯先生欠上海多人巨额债务，据悉，博物馆路34号的律师兼辩护人H. 布劳厄特（H. BROWETT）先生正代表部分债权人采取行动，试图达成和解。

在此次调查过程中，未采取任何可能使安布罗斯先生在中国海关的现有职位陷入尴尬境地的行动。

警佐 皮茨。

D. S.

el.
副警务总巡官（特务科）。

OBR

To. The Commissioner of Police
Police Headquarters
Shanghai. China.

Sir,
My name is
Mrs Aimee. I Ambrose
and I seek information regarding
the whereabouts (Domestic & business
address) of my husband
Sydney Reginald. R. Ambrose
who last wrote me from Shanghai
September 18th, 36 at which time
he was still in the employ of the
Chinese Maritime Customs as an
Examiner A post he has held for
many years. On that occasion he
asked me to take steps to secure a
divorce as his affections were
else where.
I was married to Mr. Ambrose in
Shanghai at H. M. B. Consulate

先生：
我叫艾梅·J. 安布罗斯（Mrs Aimee. J Ambrose）夫人，
我寻求了解我丈夫
西德尼·雷金纳德·R. 安布罗斯（Sydney Reginald. R. Ambrose）
的下落（家庭及办公地址），
他最后一次从上海给我写信是在1936年9月18日，当时
他仍受雇于中国海关，担任验估员，
这一职位他已担任多年。在那次通信中，
他要求我采取措施办理离婚，因为他的感情
已另有所属。
我与安布罗斯先生在上海英国驻华领事馆结婚，

by the Acting Consul C. J. Jamieson
June 19th 1925. I resided in China
for a period of ten years, my husband
being stationed first at Shanghai
then to Nantuo next to Canton
& afterwards Tchang & again Shanghai
to all of which places I accompanied
him. We last lived at The Norfolk
in Seymour Road Shanghai from
which place, I for health reasons
left for Sydney about June 16th
per Tushimi Maru leaving Hong
Kong June 19th per Atauta Maru
arrived in Sydney 13th July 25.
I have remained with my
Mother ever since.
Since the date supplied to
you 18-9-36 my husband has
not written me, nor in spite
of my repeated requests has he
sent me my fare to return to
him. I have written him
(and always in friendly terms)
regularly acknowledging small

由代理领事C. J. 詹姆森（C. J. Jamieson）主持，
时间是1925年6月19日。我在中国居住了十年，
我丈夫先是被派往上海，
然后到南市，接着去广州，
之后去镇江（Tchang），最后又回到上海，
所有这些地方的行程我都陪同他前往。我们最后住在上海西摩路的诺福克公寓（The Norfolk），
出于健康原因，我于6月16日左右离开该地前往悉尼，
乘坐“伏见丸”（Tushimi Maru）离开香港，
6月19日换乘“阿塔乌塔丸”（Atauta Maru），
于1925年7月13日抵达悉尼。
自那以后我一直与我的
母亲住在一起。
自从向您提供的日期1936年9月18日以来，
我丈夫没有再给我写过信，尽管我多次请求，
他也未寄给我返回他身边的旅费。我一直定期给他写信
（始终语气友好），确认收到他不定期寄来的小额汇款，
但这些银行汇票并未附有他的信件。

我希望回到我丈夫身边，但除非他汇来必要的钱款，否则我无法成行。
因此，如果您能提供有关安布罗斯先生目前职业的任何细节，
以及家庭事务方面的情况（鉴于他要求我与他离婚），
我将不胜感激，因为我目前处境窘迫，
